parameters.content:
# ENTRY

### - Every Telegram message lands here.
### - The Switch routes 11 commands; anything else = a guess.

# START A GAME

### - Picks the mode + playlist, then the sub-workflow finds a song with a Deezer clip (3 tries).
### - Saves the round in Sheets and sends the clip.

# CHECK A GUESS

### - Reads the round, checks the answer in code (typos OK).
### - when unsure? → AI judge. Right → point + cover + next song. Wrong → try again (silent in groups).

# SCORES

### - /score and /stop: adds up points for the current game only.
### - /stop also ends the round.

# SETUP

### - /playlist = group playlist · /mine = your playlist for /who
### - /start + /help = menu and instructions. Bad links → usage message.
### AI judge only runs for 40–80% similar guesses → most guesses cost 0 AI calls.
